meta.title: ArcheAge Event Schedule
meta.description: World bosses, rifts, PvP events, festivals and cargo ship timers for ArcheAge.

categories.name: Zone War
categories.startMessage: {event} has fallen into a state of war for {duration}.
categories.reminderMessage: {event} will fall into a state of war in {remaining}.

events.name: Troubled Spirits
events.description: Help cheer up the Ezna or Moonswept Spirits as a part of the Hallowtide festival in Two Crowns.

events.name: The Yata Lantern
events.description: The Lantern Festival in Gweonid Forest's Yata Lantern is only available for short periods of time throughout the day.

events.name: Daily Reset
events.description: All daily content unlocks again, resetting daily quests and instance entries.

events.name: Weekly Reset
events.description: Weekly quests and ArchePass missions reset.

events.name: Diamond Shores
events.description: Diamond Shores enters war four times per day.
